description:
Composition & Indication

Paroxetine 20mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Paxil®) contains Paroxetine Hydrochloride 20 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 20mg strength. The standard indication is the management of depression, anxiety and panic disorder, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Paroxetine 20mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
